stem: Which situation does NOT show causation?

options.label: A
options.text: When the student population at a school increases, the number of teachers at the school increases.

options.label: B
options.text: When the amount of sugar in a quart of apple juice is reduced, there are fewer calories in each serving.

options.label: C
options.text: When there are more workers on a project, the project is completed in less time.

options.label: D
options.text: When there is more protein in an athlete’s diet, the athlete scores more points in a game.
